name: No More Money
source: After your landlord loses his company, you and your household are forced move to another city and start from scratch. You’re 20 years old so it’s only fair that you find a job and try to help in any way you can.
translation: 当你的房东失去他的公司后，你和你的家人被迫搬到另一个城市并从头开始。你已经20岁了，所以找到一份工作并尽力提供帮助是公平的。
